description.translate: Sixteen purpur blocks required for the station frame and roof breaches. Local materials are suitable for restoring the existing design. Hand the materials to me one at a time.

Frame restored. Artifact record: Tears for Fears retained a Warden's sonic call. The ring contained dragon flight, shielding captured from the Snow Queen and vitality captured from the Hydra. Edda continued the engraving. Captured power and fully awakened use remained distinct.
